_help: Human-verified corrections — they win over every automatic source and the posted card is EDITED in place (silently, no re-ping) on the next run.
Shape: { "<game key>": { "<version>": { ...fields } } }. Game keys: genshin, starrail, zzz, wuwa, hna, ananta.
Times: unix seconds OR ISO text, e.g. "2026-11-04T06:00:00+08:00". Fields: program_ts, preinstall_ts, maint_start_ts, maint_end_ts, program_name, version_name, title_url, image, compensation.
banners: reruns, phase1, phase1_4, phase2, phase2_4, four_star (Wuthering Waves summary line) — lists of names; an empty list shows TBA.
